title: Timery Time Entry Duration Leaderboard
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=timery:entry duration_min=*
| stats sum(duration_min) as total_value, avg(duration_min) as avg_value by tag_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks tag values by total and average duration across Timery time entry events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `duration_min` values for each Timery time entry event and review total and average duration by tag.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total duration.
grandmaExplanation: It simply which tag shows the biggest duration numbers in your Timery time entry data.
